title: Leopard 120 Verbessert, World of Tanks, 2 dollars
descriptionPlain: Description The Leopard 120 Verbessert coin is struck from one ounce of pure silver in a limited mintage of 500 pieces, featuring a numbered edge and a distinctive antique finish with digital printing. The reverse depicts the Leopard 120 Verbessert tank — making its debut in the World of Tanks 2.0 update released on September 3 — rendered in high relief against a dynamic battlefield background. The obverse features the iconic “Westfield” map, known to players for its distinctive ruined viaduct. Translating tank models from the digital realm into numismatics required precision, advanced technology, and attention to every detail. The design, sculpture, and final production were all completed at Mennica Polska [Mint of Poland] — created with collectors and gamers in mind, for whom quality makes all the difference. This is our first project dedicated to the gaming community — and the only official coin from the World of Tanks universe. For us, it’s proof that numismatics can bridge worlds — tradition and innovation, collectors and players — speaking a shared language of passion and design. Every second counts on the battlefield. World of Tanks philosophy
